parameters.name: sftp_hook
parameters.description: predefined SFTPHook to use Either `sftp_hook` or `ssh_conn_id` needs to be provided.

parameters.name: ssh_conn_id
parameters.description: :ref:`ssh connection id<howto/connection:ssh>` from airflow Connections.

parameters.name: remote_host
parameters.description: remote host to connect (templated) Nullable. If provided, it will replace the `remote_host` which was defined in `sftp_hook` or predefined in the connection of `ssh_conn_id`.

parameters.name: local_filepath
parameters.description: local file path or list of local file paths to get or put. (templated)

parameters.name: remote_filepath
parameters.description: remote file path or list of remote file paths to get, put, or delete. (templated)

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: specify operation 'get', 'put', or 'delete', defaults to put

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: specify if the SFTP operation should be confirmed, defaults to True

parameters.name: create_intermediate_dirs
parameters.description: create missing intermediate directories when copying from remote to local and vice-versa. Default is False. Example: The following task would copy ``file.txt`` to the remote host at ``/tmp/tmp1/tmp2/`` while creating ``tmp``,``tmp1`` and ``tmp2`` if they don't exist. If the parameter is not passed it would error as the directory does not exist. :: put_file = SFTPOperator( task_id="test_sftp", ssh_conn_id="ssh_default", local_filepath="/tmp/file.txt", remote_filepath="/tmp/tmp1/tmp2/file.txt", operation="put", create_intermediate_dirs=True, dag=dag, )

parameters.name: concurrency
parameters.description: Number of threads when transferring directories. Each thread opens a new SFTP connection. This parameter is used only when transferring directories, not individual files. (Default is 1)

parameters.name: ssh_conn_id
parameters.description: The :ref:`sftp connection id<howto/connection:sftp>`

parameters.name: remote_host
parameters.description: remote host to connect

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: username to connect to the remote_host

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: password of the username to connect to the remote_host

parameters.name: key_file
parameters.description: path to key file to use to connect to the remote_host

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: port of remote host to connect (Default is paramiko SSH_PORT)

parameters.name: conn_timeout
parameters.description: timeout (in seconds) for the attempt to connect to the remote_host. The default is 10 seconds. If provided, it will replace the `conn_timeout` which was predefined in the connection of `ssh_conn_id`.

parameters.name: cmd_timeout
parameters.description: timeout (in seconds) for executing the command. The default is 10 seconds. Nullable, `None` means no timeout. If provided, it will replace the `cmd_timeout` which was predefined in the connection of `ssh_conn_id`.

parameters.name: keepalive_interval
parameters.description: send a keepalive packet to remote host every keepalive_interval seconds

parameters.name: banner_timeout
parameters.description: timeout to wait for banner from the server in seconds

parameters.name: disabled_algorithms
parameters.description: dictionary mapping algorithm type to an iterable of algorithm identifiers, which will be disabled for the lifetime of the transport

parameters.name: ciphers
parameters.description: list of ciphers to use in order of preference

parameters.name: auth_timeout
parameters.description: timeout (in seconds) for the attempt to authenticate with the remote_host

parameters.name: sftp_conn_id
parameters.description: SFTP connection ID to be used for connecting to SFTP server

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: hostname of the SFTP server

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: port of the SFTP server

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: username used when authenticating to the SFTP server

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: password used when authenticating to the SFTP server. Can be left blank if using a key file

parameters.name: known_hosts
parameters.description: path to the known_hosts file on the local file system. Defaults to ``~/.ssh/known_hosts``.

parameters.name: key_file
parameters.description: path to the client key file used for authentication to SFTP server

parameters.name: passphrase
parameters.description: passphrase used with the key_file for authentication to SFTP server

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Remote file or directory path

parameters.name: file_pattern
parameters.description: The pattern that will be used to match the file (fnmatch format)

parameters.name: newer_than
parameters.description: DateTime for which the file or file path should be newer than, comparison is inclusive

parameters.name: sftp_conn_id
parameters.description: The connection to run the sensor against

parameters.name: deferrable
parameters.description: If waiting for completion, whether to defer the task until done, default is ``False``.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path on the SFTP server to search for a file matching the file pattern. Authentication method used in the SFTP connection must have access to this path

parameters.name: file_pattern
parameters.description: Pattern to be used for matching against the list of files at the path above. Uses the fnmatch module from std library to perform the matching.

parameters.name: sftp_conn_id
parameters.description: SFTP connection ID to be used for connecting to SFTP server

parameters.name: poke_interval
parameters.description: How often, in seconds, to check for the existence of the file on the SFTP server

parameters.name: python_callable
parameters.description: Function to decorate
